messages:
Maya (PM): BigRetail asked to onboard a fine-tuned Llama variant and wants it pinned to a specific sha for 3 months. They require p95 <=120ms@512 and rerank parity. Can we outline a runnable plan?
Raj (Eng): We can, but need their sample traffic and eval set. If quantized fp16 we may need kernel tweaks; check KV cache semantics for chat.
Sam (CSE): On it  I'll request a 48h traffic dump and a representative eval subset. They said they'd accept a 2-week grace period for migration.
Ana (ML): Proposed gates: 1) rerank >=95% pass or <=2% relative drop vs baseline; 2) hallucination <= baseline on NER tests; 3) latency p95 <=1.3x of our profile; 4) embedding delta <0.02. Fail any -> block pin.
Leo (SRE): For hard pins we must reserve Dedicated pool capacity and adjust autoscale. Need rollback SLA and ops calendar for canary.
Raj (Eng): Pin policy proposal: soft-pin = route customer to sha but allow fallback to vetted variant when overloaded; hard-pin = reserved route, always to requested sha, ops cost higher. Default to soft unless reserved capacity paid.
Maya (PM): Negotiation path: ask for reserved commit for hard pin. Otherwise offer 90d soft pin with auto-unwind. Sam, push for reserve?
Sam (CSE): I'll negotiate. If no commit, offer 90d soft pin + discount for reserve.
Ana (ML): I'll run the onramp suite: exact-match QA, rerank AUC, perplexity on domain, latency. Gate behavior: quality_gate=block on fail; latency_gate=warn if >1.3x, block if >1.5x.
Raj (Eng): Add perf matrix fields to catalog: model_sha, quant, fp_type, p95_512, memory, kv_behavior. Sales/CS can see tradeoffs.
Maya (PM): Action items: Ana run eval (48h), Raj add perf matrix + kernel check (48h), Leo tentatively reserve pool + calendar (3bd), Sam get eval data and push reserve (24h).
Leo (SRE): Rollout SLO: 5% for 6h -> 25% for 12h -> 100% with monitors. Auto-rollback if rerank drift >2% or 5xx spike >0.5%.
Raj (Eng): Example rollout config:
```
rollout:
  - pct: 5; duration: 6h; monitors: [latency_p95, rerank_delta, 5xx_rate]
  - pct: 25; duration: 12h; monitors: [latency_p95, rerank_delta]
  - pct: 100; duration: 24h; monitors: [latency_p95, rerank_delta, error_rate]
fallback: soft_fallback: true
```
Maya (PM): Pin heuristics: hard pin requires reserved capacity + signed SLA. Soft pin = 90d TTL + weekly eval reports. Any pin >90d needs exec signoff.
Ana (ML): Safety addendum: if production signals show regression even when offline suites pass, trigger emergency rollback and audit.
Sam (CSE): Update: BigRetail prefers predictability; they're open to 90d soft pin if we provide clear migration plan and API stability promises.
Maya (PM): Decision: move forward with soft pin + 90d TTL, run onramp eval, schedule canary, present reserved capacity offer. If customer signs reserve within 14d, upgrade to hard pin. Owners: Maya (tracker), Raj (routing).
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 1795559900 (5% traffic) d will post progress to #eng-runtime.
Leo (SRE): I'll instrument alerts and cost estimate for reserved option.
Raj (Eng): Suggest catalog flags: pin_ttl, pin_type visible in console. Can prototype API by EOD.
Maya (PM): I'll capture notes in the onboarding ticket and review in Monday roadmap sync. Thanks team :thumbsup:
